summary: All acceptance criteria met, verified visually in a browser (admin/admin) with screenshots plus automated interaction tests. npm run build exits 0 (22 routes, no eslint gate); repo-wide grep for 'Coming soon'/'coming-soon'/'ComingSoon' and for '#ff9900'/'--awsui-orange-create' both return zero matches; ComingSoon.tsx, CreateZoneModal.tsx, and the /coming-soon and /resolver routes are gone. Visual confirms: sidebar groups/order/New tags/collapse + DNS Firewall external item; TopNav hamburger/logo/app-grid/centered [Alt+S] search/CloudShell/bell/account menu showing 'admin @ 123456789012' with a working Sign out; hosted-zones list (count in title, refresh, selection-gated View details/Edit/Delete, outlined-orange Create that NAVIGATES to the full page, automatic-mode helper line, 'Filter records by property or value', real Pagination + gear, six columns incl. non-sortable Created by rendering 'Route 53 console', empty-state copy); the full /hosted-zones/create page (all pinned strings, radio cards with Public default, Tags, {n}/256 counter, Cancel + outlined-orange Create -> success flashbar -> list with the new zone); full Dashboard and Health checks; every mocked sidebar page styled with correct title/count/filter/columns per the Per-page table spec; Registered domains shows the unconditional red access-denied banner with the exact pinned text. Interactive flows verified end-to-end: create zone (incl. empty-name inline-error guard with no API call), DNS record create + delete, zone edit (modal -> save -> description updated), zone delete (name-confirm gate enables Delete and removes the zone), login, logout via the account menu, bare unauthenticated login page (no sidebar/topnav), and the unauthenticated route guard redirect to /login, plus re-login. No HIGH/MEDIUM/NIT findings remain.
